Method of Attack: Encrypts files on Android external storage using AES encryption
Appends suffix of Chinese and Latin characters to encrypted files
Encrypts only files under 10KB in size
Avoids encrypting files starting with a dot or in folders with names including 'android', 'com', 'DCIM', 'download', or 'miad'
Disguised as a plugin for King of Glory mobile game
Ransom demand of 40 Chinese Renminbi ($6) via QQ, Alipay, or WeChat
Attack Vector: Spread via Chinese gaming forums disguised as a plugin for King of Glory mobile game
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note mimicking WannaCry ransom note
Suffix of Chinese and Latin characters appended to encrypted files
